name: labs/chilaslasers__pychilaslasers
title: Chilas Atlas/Comet tunable laser (pychilaslasers.laser:Laser)
intro: Chilas Atlas/Comet tunable laser (pychilaslasers.laser:Laser), adapted from chilaslasers/pychilaslasers. It reads `model`, `calibrated`, `diode_enabled`, `diode_current` and 4 more; sets `system_state`; runs `turn_on`, `turn_off`, `trigger_pulse`, `set_diode_current` and 1 more. `turn_on`: enable the laser system output (SYST:STAT 1). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
